question.text: A bull call spread with 10 lots: Buy 83.00 call at 0.10, Sell 83.50 call at 0.04. USDINR at expiry = 83.30. What is total P&L?

explanation.text: The Logic: Long 83 call gains 83.30 - 83.00 - 0.10 = Rs. 0.20. Short 83.50 call expires worthless (spot 83.30 < strike 83.50), so the seller retains the Rs. 0.04 premium. Net = Rs. 0.24 per USD. With 1 USDINR option contract = 1000 USD, total profit = 10 lots x 1000 x 0.24 = Rs. 2,400. The Trap: At 83.30, only the lower strike call is exercised; the higher strike call expires worthless. Note: Between the two strikes, P&L varies linearly with spot. Below both strikes or above both, P&L is fixed.
